onExpiry: require fresh principal SAS handoff to consult archives

vfs.autoArchive: archive latest available encrypted feed when SAS lease activates

privateMirror.desiredDestination: Gvault private / Vigie-side Control Tower VFS mirror
privateMirror.note: The browser cannot write to the private repository without a server-side authenticated bridge. Until that bridge exists, mirror operations remain local and explicit.

security.publicVfsMeaning: browser storage attached to the public Gvault-Pages origin, not plaintext files committed into the public repository

promotionTests: no SAS -> Control Tower content invisible
principal SAS -> 5:00 lease starts without second prompt
available encrypted feed -> live data opens and ciphertext snapshot auto-archives
lease expiry -> live plaintext/feed locks and secret is wiped
fresh principal SAS -> existing VFS snapshot decrypts and can be inspected
delete one removes local snapshot and creates mirror deletion intent
VIDER VFS removes all local snapshots and creates DELETE_ALL mirror intent
